meta.title: Competitions
meta.description: Drawing, painting, craft, essay, photography and video competitions about animals, for children and young adults in India.

hero.title: Make something about an animal you know
hero.lead: Each competition gives you a theme about animals and kindness. You draw, paint, build, write, photograph or film your answer, and real judges look at every entry.
hero.easy: Pick a competition. Make your picture, story or film. Everyone who takes part gets a certificate.
hero.photoCaption: Crayons, paints and paper: all you need for most competitions.

list.title: Open and coming up
list.lead: Choose what you like to make and your age to see the competitions that fit.
list.sampleNote: These are sample competitions, shown on test sites only.

filters.label: Filter the competitions
filters.note: The list changes as you choose. Nothing is sent anywhere.

endCard.title: Not seeing one for you?
endCard.body: New competitions appear here first. A school that wants one for its students can write to us.

empty.title: The first competition is being planned
empty.body: When it is ready, you will find its theme, age groups, dates and fee right here. Schools can write to us now to hear first.

own.title: Taking part on your own
own.lead: A student should not be required to participate through a school.
own.body: If your school is not part of a competition, a parent or guardian can sign you up with us directly. You make your entry at home, it goes to the same judges, and you get the same certificate.
own.adult: You create the account, give the consents for your child and, where there is a fee, pay it. Your child's work is judged on the entry code alone. We show a child's first name and the first letter of the surname (like Aarav S.), never a photo, age, school address or contact details.

register.label: Register for this competition
register.title: Online registration opens with the first real competition
register.body: We are building sign-up so that consent, safety and payments work properly from day one. Until then, a school or a parent can write to us and we will reply with the steps.

opensSoon.label: Registration opens {date}
opensSoon.title: Registration has not opened yet
opensSoon.body: You can read everything about this competition now. Schools can start planning: the theme and dates below will not change without notice.

underway.label: Entries are being judged
underway.title: This competition is underway
underway.body: Registration has closed. If you already have an entry, your dashboard will show its progress once accounts are switched on.

results.label: See the results
results.title: Results pages are coming
results.body: Results will be published here with first names and initials only. That page is being built.

cancelled.label: This competition was cancelled
cancelled.title: This competition was cancelled
cancelled.body: Every fee paid for it is refunded in full. See the refunds page for how that works.

categories.title: Who can enter, and with what
categories.lead: Your age group is set by your age on {date}. You may enter once in each category.
categories.caption: Categories by discipline and age group

timeline.title: Dates to remember
timeline.lead: All times are Indian Standard Time.

school.title: Through your school
school.line: We encourage you to participate through your school.
school.body: Your teacher runs the competition in class. The school judges first and sends its best entries to us.

self.title: On your own
self.body: A parent or guardian signs you up. You make your entry at home and upload it before the closing date.

recognition.title: Every way we recognise good work

items.participation: A participation certificate for everyone who takes part
items.merit: School merit certificates, chosen by your school's own judges
items.finalist: Finalist certificates for entries that reach the FOA round
items.winner: Winner and runner-up awards in each category
items.featured: Featured work shown in our public gallery and awareness campaigns, with consent

recognition.prizesBody: Prizes for this competition are still being decided. They will be listed here before entries close.

files.title: How to send your entry

typeNames.image: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo
typeNames.essay: Typed in the editor, or a PDF or Word file

countNames.art: 1 main photo, plus up to 2 more views
countNames.craft: 2 to 6 photos: front, side and close-up

files.minVideo: {px} pixels on the short side, 10 seconds to 3 minutes

items.own: The work must be your own. A grown-up may help you set up, but the ideas and the making are yours.
items.once: One entry for each category you register for.
items.animals: Never chase, hold or disturb an animal for a photo or a film. Watch from a distance and let it be.
items.consent: If you are under 18, a parent or guardian gives consent before you enter.
items.theme: Your entry should answer the theme. Judges give it the most weight.

physical.title: If we ask for your original
physical.body: For drawing, painting, art and craft, finalists may be asked to post the original so judges can see it in person. Keep it flat, dry and safe until results are out.
physical.who: Through school, your teacher sends it. On your own, a parent or guardian posts it. The packing note will say who pays for postage. Friends of Animals never charges you to get your work back.

display.title: Showing your work
display.body: With your consent, and a parent's or guardian's if you are under 18, selected entries may appear in our public gallery and awareness campaigns. We credit you by first name and initial only.
display.noAuction: There is no auction in this competition. Your work will not be sold.

consent.title: Consent and policies
consent.body: Before you register you will be asked to agree to these. You can read them now.

help.title: Questions?
help.body: Ask us anything about this competition, before or after you register.
